title: epacris rubra
intro: Epacris rubra, commonly known as the Red Epacris or Red Leptospermum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. It is a shrub native to Australia, known for its vibrant red flowers and potential health benefits. The Red Epacris is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, depression, and other health issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its health benefits, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
